info.cls_ename: Master's Program, Department of International Business

description.describe_ch: 本課程主要是介紹國際行銷的理論與實務上的運作，研究生藉此可將國際行銷的概念運用於學術研究、工作和日常生活中。
description.describe_eh: This course is designed to help graduate students understand the theory of international marketing and its practice in the business. Through this class, graduate students should be able to use the theory concept of strategic marketing in the academic research and their daily life and work in the near future.

targets.describe_ch: 能瞭解並應用國際行銷理論之基本概念。
targets.describe_en: Comprehension for the basic concept and the implications of international marketing theory.

targets.describe_ch: 能分析國際行銷的問題。
targets.describe_en: Analysis of the international marketing problems.
